$comment: TSK-0105 performance budgets. Values come only from HH-NFR-01 (engineering targets of the functionality guide, configured values per OWN-DEC-59 and OWN-DEC-122); they are internal engineering targets, never customer promises. A null value is NOT CONFIGURED: it is measured and reported, never enforced; the PROPOSED values wait in OQ-PERF-BUDGET-DETAILS. apps/server/test/integration/performance-budgets.test.ts (CI) and apps/server/test/perf/measure.test.ts read this file; tools/perf-bundles.mjs reads the bundle section.

staff_read.source: HH-NFR-01: staff key reads p95 <= 800 ms excluding third-party calls, on representative staging (10,000 jobs, 20 concurrent active users, paginated queries)

core_write.source: HH-NFR-01: core writes p95 <= 1.5 s excluding provider waiting (submission, acceptance, schedule and start)

customer_read.source: NOT CONFIGURED: HH-NFR-01 sets page targets for customer pages (LCP, INP, CLS at field p75), not an API latency; see OQ-PERF-BUDGET-DETAILS

export.source: NOT CONFIGURED: HH-NFR-01 does not name exports; see OQ-PERF-BUDGET-DETAILS

pages.$comment: Field targets at p75 (mobile and desktop) once enough real samples exist. Lab results are a proxy, reported as lab, never as field.

bundles.$comment: Gzip bytes per app build. NOT CONFIGURED: HH-NFR-01 asks for no large hero assets or heavy scripts but gives no number; the PROPOSED limits are in OQ-PERF-BUDGET-DETAILS.
